title: DDL_LOCK_TIMEOUT set to a value Oracle rejects — session left unprotected
expected_feedback: Critical: DDL_LOCK_TIMEOUT takes an integer in [0, 1000000], so -1 makes the ALTER SESSION itself fail. In a deploy log that error is one line among many and is easy to miss, and the session then carries on with the parameter at its default of 0 — NOWAIT. The result is worse than omitting the line: the script reads as protected while every DDL after it is unguarded, and the ALTER TABLE fails with ORA-00054 the moment any session holds a transient lock on this 9M-row table. Use a small positive integer, and make the deploy tooling fail the run on any error rather than continuing past one.
violated_rule: DDL_LOCK_TIMEOUT set before every DDL session
